summary: Simultaneous card-melding game where players try to hit the majority color without busting its limit, or trigger exact Kododo count.
rules_text: Shuffle 100 cards (20 each in 5 colors, with point values 1-6; 5 per color are Kododos). Remove a number face-down by player count. Deal 5 cards to each player, rest as draw pile. Each round has 3 simultaneous turns: turn 1 each player plays 2 face-down cards, then draws 2; turns 2-3 each play 1 and draw 1. So 4 cards per player are revealed each round. Scoring: first check if total Kododos in play equals players+2. If yes, only players who played Kododos score them. If not, count cards per color. The most-played color scores, but if its total >= players+3 it busts and is discarded and you check the next most-played. If tied for majority, all tied colors are discarded. Scored cards go to a face-down score pile. Discard others. When draw pile empty, play one final round without drawing, discard last card, sum scores. Highest total wins, tie break most scored cards.
rating_reason: Simultaneous color bidding with bust threshold, perfect bluffing game.
